results.expect: includes plover season status and fire rules with sources, unprompted; cites
results.answer:
Bonfires are only allowed in the provided fire rings between Stairwells 15 and 20 [NPS Ocean Beach page](https://www.nps.gov/goga/planyourvisit/oceanbeach.htm). 

However, there is a winter no-burn season from November 1 through February 28 to avoid the Bay Area air district's Spare the Air season [NPS beach fire rules](https://www.nps.gov/goga/learn/management/fire_beachfireregs.htm). Since it is currently November, bonfires are not permitted.

Also, the western snowy plovers are wintering here through May 15. If you head to the beach, please walk the wet sand near the water rather than the upper beach, and keep dogs on a six-foot leash in the protection area [NPS Ocean Beach page](https://www.nps.gov/goga/planyourvisit/oceanbeach.htm).

results.expect: uses the block the neighbor shared without asking for cross streets; cites
results.answer:
Your block sits about 39 feet above sea level, and most of the homes were built around 1941 (SF Assessor-Recorder's 2023 roll). Like every block here, yours is built on a thick layer of dune sand (USGS).

A few things nearby:
* **Patriotic Homes**: Two blocks east, builders gave model homes hopeful names before WWII halted construction, like the Rainbow House (1941) and Freedom House (1942) [Doelger Architecture](https://www.outsidelands.org/doelger-types.php).
* **Shipwrecks**: About 0.3 miles southwest, the hull of the clipper ship *King Philip* (wrecked 1878) is buried in the sand and occasionally surfaces after winter storms [NPS](https://home.nps.gov/goga/learn/historyculture/vestiges-shipwrecks.htm).
* **Old Photos**: The [OpenSFHistory](https://opensfhistory.org) archive has photographs pinned right at 46th and Moraga.

Do you know anything about your block you'd like to share?
